svg.title: KV cache growth vs. two hard ceilings
svg.desc: Line chart of KV cache size in GB for one sequence against context length in tokens, from 0 to about 460,000. Three straight lines by construction (bytes per token is constant): Llama-3-8B at 131 KB/token, Llama-3-70B at 328 KB/token, and DeepSeek-V3 with MLA at about 70 KB/token. Two dashed reference lines mark 80 GB, one H100's memory, and 140 GB, the BF16 weight size of Llama-3-70B. The 70B curve is marked where it crosses the 140 GB weights line, at approximately 427,000 tokens of context.

text.font-family: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
